all.name: Doctor Strange
all.description: As the Sorcerer Supreme, Dr. Stephen Strange gracefully wields ancient spells to turn the tide of even the most impossible battle. However, magic always comes at a cost, and each use of his arcane abilities gradually awakens the darkness within him.

additional_fields.Fire_Rate: 5.56 rounds per second, with a 0.03-second interval between every two rounds
additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 80% at 20m

item.name: Shield Of The Seraphim
item.description: Create a protective barrier against damage.

item.name: Maelstrom Of Madness
item.description: Release <Orange>Dark Magic</> to deal damage to nearby enemies.

additional_fields.Damage: Each point of Dark Magic deals 1.3 damage
additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster

item.name: Gamma Maelstrom
item.description: Hulk charges Black Panther and The Thing with gamma radiation. When Black Panther's health is low, he gains a gamma shield, becoming <Buff>Unstoppable</> and blocking attacks. The Thing gains Gamma Gauntlets, boosting <Buff>Damage</> and range of his <Orange>Rocky Jab</> and <Orange>Stone Haymaker</>. Dealing damage with these attacks grants <Buff>Bonus Health</>, and maximum <Buff>Bonus Health</> cap is increased.

item.name: Psionic Vortex
item.description: Invisible Woman enhances Doctor Strange's <Orange>Maelstrom of Madness</> with a psionic explosion. The explosion damages and pulls enemies toward Doctor Strange. Based on the explosion's damage, Doctor Strange and nearby allies gain <Buff>Bonus Health</>.

additional_fields.Damage: Each point of energy deals 1.3 damage.
additional_fields.Special_Effect: The spell field pulls enemies in range toward Doctor Strange

item.name: Pentagram Of Farallah
item.description: Open portals between two locations, enabling all units to travel through them.

item.name: Eye Of Agamotto
item.description: Separate nearby enemies' <Orange>Souls</> from their bodies. Damage dealt to these <Orange>Souls</> is transferred to their physical bodies.

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster

item.name: Price Of Magic
item.description: <Orange>Dark Magic</> accumulates with every hit on an enemy. If <Orange>Dark Magic</> peaks for too long, Doctor Strange will be cursed with <Debuff>Anti-Heal</>.

additional_fields.Generate_Dark_Magic: Daggers of Denak: Each hit generates 3.5 Dark Magic. When using the V key, every enemy hit generates 10 Dark Magic

item.name: Cloak Of Levitation
item.description: Ascend and then enter a brief state of sustained flight.

item.name: Enchanted Enhancement
item.description: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery with Scarlet Witch and Magik. Scarlet Witch's <Orange>Chthonian Burst</> is replaced with <Orange>Mystic Burst</> upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction. Magik can unleash a <Orange>Chain of Cyttorak</> that links two enemies and slows them; the farther they are apart, the greater the <Debuff>Slow</> effect inflicted during the link.
